create_empty_hub_dataset_repo: create an empty Hugging Face dataset repository with optional files and gating settings
delete_hub_dataset_repo: delete a Hugging Face dataset repository by its repo id
create_temporary_dataset: create a temporary Hugging Face dataset resource that auto-allocates and releases on context exit
fetch_bot_discussion: fetch the bot discussion details for a Hugging Face dataset repository
close_discussion: close a Hugging Face dataset discussion by its discussion number
